bookSourceComment:
番茄小说TS ｜ 小说 / 听书 / 短剧 多模式聚合

【使用】
· 听书/短剧：进入章节自动弹出解密播放器（选集/倍速/锁屏/续播）
· 段评：点正文气泡打开评论页（可在菜单关闭）
· 搜索前缀：+3小说 ／ +2听书 ／ +11短剧 ／ +书号直达
· 漫画：站内暂无数据

ruleBookInfo.author: $.author
ruleBookInfo.init:
<js>
fqUse(java, source, cache);
var raw = result;
if (typeof raw === 'string') { try { raw = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (e) { raw = null; } }
var o = (raw && raw.data) ? raw.data : raw;
var t = String((o && o.type) || '');
var bid = String((o && (o.book_id || o.series_id)) || '');
var mode = fqModeOf(t);
fqSet('mode', mode);
fqSet('bookId', bid);
try { java.put('bookId', bid); } catch (e) {}
var last = '';
if (bid) {
  try {
    var cj = JSON.parse(String(java.ajax(fqHost() + '/catalog?book_id=' + bid) || '{}'));
    var cd = (cj && cj.data) ? cj.data : cj;
    var il = (cd && cd.item_data_list) || [];
    if (il.length) last = String(il[il.length - 1].title || '');
  } catch (e) {}
}
result = JSON.stringify({
  bookId: bid,
  mode: mode,
  type: t,
  name: String((o && (o.book_name || o.title)) || ''),
  author: String((o && (o.author || o.copyright)) || ''),
  coverUrl: String((o && (o.cover_url || o.cover || o.audio_thumb_url_hd)) || ''),
  intro: String((o && (o.abstract || o.video_desc || o.intro)) || ''),
  lastChapter: last,
  wordCount: String((o && (o.word_count || o.episode_cnt)) || ''),
  kind: String(t || '未知') + '｜' + String((o && o.score) || '-') + '分',
  tocUrl: fqHost() + '/catalog?book_id=' + bid
});
result;
</js>
